stem.text: Which statement about the properties associated with the different types of bonding involved is correct?

A.text: Any covalent compound that contains both oxygen and hydrogen in its molecule forms hydrogen bonds.

B.text: Ionic bonds and covalent bonds cannot both occur in the same compound.

C.text: Ionic compounds differ from metals in that ionic compounds do not conduct electricity in the solid state.

D.text: The only covalent compounds with high melting points are those in which hydrogen bonds occur.
